verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is a hosted payments and open-banking API service. Self-hosting is a fair axis for this kind of product, but nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core platform. The open-source signing libraries and SDKs are client-side building blocks and do not count as self-hosting the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
